video_overlay_text_observed: Cover card: 'COVID-19 “VACCINES” INCREASE YOUR RISK OF 7 MAJOR CANCERS' + per-cancer percentages (Breast +54%, Prostate +69%, Lung +53%, Bladder +62%, Colon +35%, Stomach +34%, Thyroid +35%); lower-third 'NICOLAS HULSCHER, MPH'.
implied_frame: Frames the COVID mRNA vaccine as a cause of a cancer epidemic ('turbo cancer'). The two cited cohort studies (S. Korea n=8.4M; Italy n=296K) are real and report elevated cancer hazard ratios in vaccinated cohorts, but both are observational and report associations, not causation — the Italian study's signal reverses at a 12-month lag and shows lower all-cause death in the vaccinated. The caption's 7-cancer percentage list is a composite cherry-picked across the two studies. The '100,000 excess cancer deaths since 2021' CDC figure is unsupported (CDC/SEER show cancer death rates declining); the '100+ studies / 17 mechanisms' is the McCullough Foundation's own literature review.
capture_method: Pristine original media + metadata pulled from Instagram's CDN via yt-dlp; delivery webm derived once (VP9 video copied, audio normalized to -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP off the source AAC — no re-recording, no in-place re-encode).
